description: Adds practitioners to the account's roster for monthly monitoring (up to 500 per call). It adds rows only and does not delete or overwrite existing ones. It does not return screening results: results arrive with the next monitoring run and are read with get_receipt (roster_id + period). Each entry needs NPI + first name + last name. Quota or prepaid debit is applied as POST /api/v1/rosters/bulk applies it (one unit per newly enrolled license; duplicates and failures are free; prepaid live keys also need the enterprise deposit floor). Sandbox keys enrol sample data only; nothing is screened for real. Not covered: instant results, people without an NPI. Results are possible matches only, drawn from the public lists named in the report. StatuteWire does not verify identity and does not determine employment or credentialing eligibility. You alone must confirm each result with the official source and make every employment and compliance decision. Needs an API key (Authorization: Bearer sw_live_… or sw_test_…); without one it returns an error that points to how_to_get_access.
name: screen_roster
title: Add practitioners to monthly monitoring
